column1: # EXP-R2-241 ProtGPT3-1.3B context-information qualification, re-measured under
# the checkpoint's native rendering.
# WHY THIS RUN EXISTS. ProtGPT3-1.3B was scored as `raw` -- a bare residue string
# -- and returned a displacement-corrected 8-block envelope of [-0.2941, -0.1258]
# nats/token, i.e. below its held-out unigram baseline on all eight blocks. The
# checkpoint's own card declares a different format: two "directional" tokens, "1"
# for N-to-C and "2" for C-to-N, "which should be placed at the start of the
# protein sequence (i.e., after the BOS token) to select the direction", loaded
# with add_bos_token=True. The arm's `input_format` was `raw` on the reasoning
# that the published tokenizer_config.json has add_bos_token False and a
# Sequence-only post-processor -- which is what the tokenizer does unconfigured,
# not what the model was trained on. `input_format` is now
# `bos_direction_seq`; nothing else about the estimand, the cohort, the reference,
# the dtype, the seed or the bootstrap changed.
# The format effect was measured first, on the gate's own block 0 (band 64-246,
# n=200, digest 17f1ca32b288) with the gate's own held-out 3998-record reference:
# raw 3.0495 nats/residue (context information -0.1767) against BOS+direction+seq
# 1.7957 (context information +1.0825), BOS+seq 2.6929 (+0.1854), direction+seq
# 1.8843 (+0.9940), and the reverse-direction control BOS+"2"+seq 2.8324
# (+0.0458). After <|bos|> the model puts 0.499998 of its next-token mass on "1",
# 0.499998 on "2" and ~0 on the rest of its 31-wide head.
# THIS MANIFEST IS A NEW MEASUREMENT, NOT A CORRECTION OF THE OLD ONE. New run-id,
# new artefacts, new cohort-name, and the recorded [-0.2941, -0.1258] is left
# exactly as it is until stage 41 has produced the corrected envelope. A FAIL or
# an interval containing zero is a completed measurement and is reported as one.
# The draw is the eight frozen EXP-R2-216/224/240 blocks, unchanged: pool 4000,
# --cohort-draw-seed 20260728, --cohort-skip 7000k for k = 0..7, band 64-246,
# n 200, held-out unigram reference 4000, --seed 20260727. Cohort.digest hashes
# records only and the records are the same ones, so each cell's expect basename
# carries that block's existing digest: a cell that drew anything else writes a
# differently named file and is reported no-artifact rather than silently paired
# against a block it does not share.
# --allow-candidate-arms is this campaign's door and admits only
# STAGED_CANDIDATE_ARMS. bfloat16 as before. --skip-truncation because the
# truncation curve is not this measurement. The rendering adds two tokens per
# record (BOS and the direction token); the longest record in the band is 246
# residues, so 248 tokens, and no truncation reaches it.
# gpu and slot are packed for a 4-GPU allocation: four blocks share a slot on
# cuda:0..3 and two slots finish the eight. TRANSFER_PYTHON is the GPFS ct
# runtime (overrides h200_env.sh ac2).
